props.children: Everything the library builds is described by JSON objects, the meta of the app. There are six kinds, told apart by the type field, which every object must have: page, layout, panel, table, form and field.

The containers declare their fields once, keyed by id, and place them with a grid per screen size: rows top to bottom, columns left to right, one field id per column. A field is the atom; it never contains other objects. Its type is the name of a component folder in src/components/ui, and its props are that component's props.
type is always present. For a container it is one of page, layout, panel, table, form; for a field it is a component name or a built-in (children, nav, text).
id is unique within its folder for containers and within the file for fields; it is the stable handle for grids, tests and references.
A field's props must match the props of its component, no more and no less. Unknown keys are an error, not ignored.
